scenarios.title: Shadow planner on: at the checkpoints the `planner shadow:` line names the same attack as the combat profile
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 18 with the points a played level gives; the autopilot spends them from the plan table so the hero has the table's skills. Reachable by play.
scenarios.notes: Uses the log_line assertion (the shadow planner writes only a bot log line, the dump cannot show it). The line is written once a minute, so a 5 virtual minute run holds several. Offline equivalent on every merge: internal/agency TestPlannerAgreementFixture. Agreement is asserted for the Sorceress only: a Paladin on paladin-zealot-lite at clvl 18 is a documented mismatch (the estimate prefers Sacrifice over Zeal), so the Paladin is asserted to produce the line and no 'no plan' warning. The knob is shadow only: the hero's play must equal a run with agency.planner 0, so no_writes. The window is a linear map of the log's wall clock to virtual minutes (U).

assert.why: the shadow planner ran and wrote its line
the planner found a plan for the bought skills
the plan names the attack the combat profile plays
